notes.title: 64-bit macOS support added!
notes.content:
🎉 Exciting News for macOS Users! 🎉

We're thrilled to announce that Ghostory now supports 64-bit on macOS!

After Steam has removed 32-bit only games from the store, you can now dive back into the charming world of Ghostory and continue your adventure!

We can't wait to hear your feedback!

Happy gaming,
RigidCore Games

notes.title: 6 Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30753360/5d42cbabad24432a51f7cf370d89507f4f893b04.png[/img]

Hello, Ghostory fans!

It's soon to be 6 years since Ghostory was released. It's been an incredible journey, and we thank you all for your support.

We're thankful for each and every one of you who has explored the perilous caves of our game and we would love to get more people to enjoy it the same. Therefore, we would kindly ask you all to leave the game a Steam review! They help the game get more visibility and influence players when deciding about their purchase. Thank you so much!

To give back, we're conjuring an 80% discount over the next week. Now is the perfect time to introduce your friends, family, and fellow adventurers to the wonders of Ghostory. Let's welcome new travellers into our community!

Additionally, in preparation to celebrate Halloween, the carved pumpkins make their return into the main menu again for the duration of the month. Get spooked!

Once again, thank you all,

RigidCore Games team

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30753360/c7ebd2b93670d598486c4c3c7ce531783cecc93e.gif[/img]
Halloween is here again! Since it's the most ghastly time of the year, we are celebrating early this time. Together with some bugfixes and small updates, this new patch makes all main menu backgrounds spookified by pumpkins! They will stay only until the end of the halloween season, make sure you don't miss them.
However, halloween is not the only thing to celebrate. Tomorrow it's our 2-year release anniversary. So, we have one more announcement: a 75% sale! It's the biggest we've had so far, make sure to let your friends know so they can lift their spirits with some puzzles as well.

notes.title: 11 new languages to get punned in!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30753360/0be61c5664988ab936b1a5ecf1fdccd9ceaf089a.png[/img]

The more languages you know, the more you are a ghost!

Over half a year has passed since the release of Ghostory last October. We've tried to stay in close touch with the community in the meantime and brought you updates regularly.

However, we've always known there is a big mass of players out there that would enjoy Ghostory, but couldn't. That's why we decided to extend the pool of languages in which Ghostory can be played - so today, in the biggest post-release update so far, we are proud to present you the following translations:

Brazilian-Portuguese, Bulgarian, Danish, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish and Swedish!

To finish this update off, we are also launching a two-week 40% discount!

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Hey Ghostory fans! We know it took us a bit more than we expected. However, the time has finally come and wait will soon be over - as on the 23rd of October, the game will finally be released!

Get ready and make sure not to miss it right as it comes out, so that you know how the story ends first! It won't be easy though, as dozens of levels full of original handmade puzzles are awaiting. Will you try to rush through the game in under 7 hours, or will you try to explore everything the cave has to offer hunting for all the achievements? The choice is yours!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30753360/4045d2e6fd4393d31d4f9e485747bcc8e06c943c.png[/img]
